messages.text:
The backend tests are now green.

The build completes the client bundle and fails only in the SSR bundle because `@tanstack/react-start` expects a newer `@tanstack/react-router` patch in the same 1.120 line; I’m aligning those TanStack patch versions and fixing the router export name collision.
